latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Offer Naming: MAGIC Formula skill.
- Provides a five-component naming framework (magnetic reason, target audience, goal, time interval, container word) to generate 3–5 testable offer name variants.
- Includes a detailed, step-by-step process for naming new offers or refreshing existing ones.
- Offers guidelines for component selection, combination, and testing for optimal results.
- Produces a prioritized offer name refresh plan to combat audience fatigue.
